name: latex-render
description: Renders LaTeX math in Claude's replies: display math as crisp images (kitty graphics protocol), inline math as Unicode

images.title: Display math as images
images.description: auto: on in kitty, Ghostty and WezTerm outside tmux; on: always; off: Unicode text only

color.title: Formula color
color.description: Hex color such as #e6e6e6, or auto to follow the light or dark theme

scale.title: Formula scale
scale.description: Terminal rows taken by one line of LaTeX text (1.25 is a little larger than the text around it)

cellAspect.title: Cell aspect ratio
cellAspect.description: Height of a terminal cell divided by its width; raise it if formulas look squashed, lower it if they look stretched

preamble.title: Extra LaTeX preamble
preamble.description: Added after amsmath, amssymb, mathtools and bm, e.g. \usepackage{physics}
